name: OIDC-Auth
description: Advanced OIDC authentication with role-based library access control
overview: OpenID Connect SSO with granular role-to-library mapping, multi-provider support, and a full admin configuration UI.
changelog: BREAKING: requires Jellyfin 12.0 or newer; 10.10/10.11 servers stay on 0.3.3. Retargeted to .NET 10 and Jellyfin.Controller 12.0.0. New: profile pictures synced from the OIDC picture claim behind a full SSRF guard; login buttons injected into the web UI automatically; optional server-wide require-SSO mode with admin and LAN escape hatches; Quick Connect bridge so Android/iOS/Android TV apps can sign in with SSO. Fixes: SSO login no longer hangs on plain-HTTP LAN servers (crypto.randomUUID is secure-context only); the admin config round-trip no longer resets EmailClaim, AutoLinkByVerifiedEmail, EnforceSsoOnLink, AllowInsecureAuthority or AllowedSigningAlgorithms; account Link/Unlink now resolve the current user correctly; config validation errors surface as 400 with a reason instead of an opaque 500.
